items.question: Is Īśāna repeatedly declared lord of all vidyās by the śrutis?
premises: The citation names Īśāna as lord of all vidyās.
The śrutis are given as the declaring authority.
items.inference: The verse affirms repeated śruti authority for Īśāna's lordship over all vidyās.
uncertainties: The token is a fused quoted phrase, so its exact citation boundary is unclear.
The verse gives no further doctrinal elaboration beyond the citation.
items.plain_english: The śrutis repeatedly declare Īśāna lord of all vidyās, and so forth.
